why_ai: Delivery and recommendation automate, but nine-figure commissioning bets on unmade titles stay judgment-heavy.
why_clarity: Nobody can attribute subscribers to titles, so content value is decided by instinct.
why_digital: Video is licensed, recommended and streamed entirely online to remote subscribers.

why_ai: Inventory forecasting, allocation and frequency capping are well-posed ad tech optimisation.
why_clarity: Fill rate, delivery and frequency are measured on every ad break.
why_digital: Ad inventory is forecast, sold and served entirely through software.

why_ai: Churn prediction and intervention on first-party viewing data is standard ML.
why_clarity: Cancellations and returns are observed directly for every subscriber.
why_digital: Subscriber data and interventions run entirely in the platform.

why_ai: Forecasting an unmade title from a script and comparables is novel, sparse and high-stakes.
why_clarity: Each title is one-off, and its worth is known only long after release, if ever.
why_digital: Scripts, comparables and audience data are analysed on screen.

why_ai: Valuing and choosing billions in content combines causal ambiguity with high-stakes bets.
why_clarity: Hours viewed is measured, but causal value of a title is contested.
why_digital: Viewing data and content decisions are worked entirely on screen.

why_ai: Recommendation is the category's strongest ML capability and keeps automating.
why_clarity: Engagement is measured instantly, though retention effects take months.
why_digital: Viewing events in, ranked rows out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Subtitles, dubs, tags and descriptions are generation tasks AI is rapidly taking over.
why_clarity: Assets are produced per title to spec in dozens of languages, though quality is partly subjective.
why_digital: Video and text in, subtitles, dubs and metadata out, all digital.

why_ai: Load forecasting and graceful degradation are engineering problems automation handles.
why_clarity: A launch either streams for everyone or fails in public, instantly.
why_digital: Video delivery infrastructure is engineered and operated entirely in software.

why_ai: Creator relationships are genuine assets and nine-figure commitments rest on personal judgment.
why_clarity: Executives are judged on outcomes nobody can measure, with no known track record.
why_digital: Decks and scripts are digital, but decisions run through meetings and creator relationships.

why_ai: Checking assets against a specification is detection work that automated QC routes.
why_clarity: Every asset passes or fails a written specification of quality and compliance checks.
why_digital: Video, audio and subtitle files are reviewed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Causal inference over viewing data is analytical work AI can perform given better design.
why_clarity: Attribution methods are contested and the true counterfactual is never observed.
why_digital: Subscriber viewing data analysed entirely on screen.
